verses: Alif Laam Ra, yeh roshan kitab ki aayaten hain
Yaqeenan hum ney uss ko Quran arabi nazil farmaya hai kay tum samajh sako
Hum aap kay samney behtareen biyan paish kertay hain uss wajah say kay hum ney aap ki janib yeh Quran wahee kay zariye nazil kiya aur yaqeenan aap uss say pehlay bey khabron mein say thay
Jab kay Yusuf ney apney baap say zikar kiya kay abba jaan mein ney giyara sitaron ko aur sooraj chand ko dekha kay woh sab mujhay sajdah ker rahey hain
Yaqoob alaihi as-salam ney kaha piyaray bachay! apney uss khuwab ka zikar apney bhaiyon say na kerna. Aisa na ho kay woh teray sath koi fareb kaari keren, shetan to insan ka khulla dushman hai

Aur ussi tarah tujhay tera perwerdigar bargazeedah keray ga aur tujhay moamla fehmi (ya khuwabon ki tabeer) bhi sikhaye ga aur apni nemat tujhay bharpoor ata farmaye ga aur Yaqoob kay ghar walon ko bhi, jaisay kay uss ney uss say pehlay teray dada aur per-dada yani Ibrahim o Ishaq ko bhi bharpoor apni nemat di, yaqeenan tera rab boht baray ilm wala aur zabardast hikmat wala hai
Yaqeenan Yusuf aur uss kay bhaiyon mein daryaft kerney walon kay liye (bari) nishaniyan hain
Jab kay unhon ney kaha kay Yusuf aur uss ka bhai ba nisbat humaray, baap ko boht ziyadah piyaray hain halankay hum (taqatwar) jamat hain koi shak nahi kay humaray abba sareeh ghalati mein hain
Yusuf ko to maar hi dalo ya ussay kissi (maloom) jagah phenk do kay tumharay walid ka rukh sirf tumhari taraf hi ho jaye. Uss kay baad tum nek ho jana
Unn mein say aik ney kaha Yusuf ko qatal to na kero balkay)yeh ussay kissi andhay koowen (ki teh) mein daal aao kay ussay koi (aata jata) qafila utha ley jaye agar tumhen kerna hi hai to yun kero
Unhon ney kaha abba! aakhir aap Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) kay baray mein hum per aitbaar kiyon nahi kertay hum to uss kay khair khuwah hain
Kul aap ussay zaroor humaray sath bhej dijiye kay khoob khaye piye aur khelay, uss ki hifazat kay hum zimmay daar hain
(Yaqoob alaihi as-salam ney) kaha ussay tumhara ley jana mujhay to sakht sadma dey ga aur mujhay yeh bhi khutka laga rahey ga kay tumhari ghaflat mein ussay bheyriya kha jaye
Unhon ney jawab diya kay hum jaisi (zor aawar) jamat ki mojoodgi mein bhi agar ussay bheyriya kha jaye to hum bilkul nikammay hi huye

Phir jab ussay ley chalay aur sab ney mill ker thaan liya kay ussay ghair abad gehray koowen ki teh mein phenk den, hum ney Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ki taraf wahee ki kay yaqeenan (waqt aaraha hai kay) to unhen uss majra ki khabar uss haal mein dey ga kay woh jantay hi na hun
Aur isha kay waqt (woh sab) apney baap kay pass rotay huye phonchay

Aur kehney lagay kay abba jaan hum to aapas mein dor mein lag gaye aur Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ko hum ney asbaab kay pass chora pus ussay bheyriya kha gaya, aap to humari baat nahi manen gay, go hum bilkul sachay hi hun

Aur Yusuf kay kertay ko jhoot moot kay khoon say khoon aalood bhi ker laye thay, baap ney kaha yun nahi, balkay)yeh tum ney apney dil hi say aik baat bana li hai. Pus sabar hi behtar hai, aur tumhari banaee hui baaton per Allah hi say madad ki talab hai

Aur aik qafila aaya aur unhon ney apney pani laney walay ko bheja uss ney apna dol latka diya, kehney laga waah waah khushi ki baat hai yeh to aik larka hai, unhon ney ussay maal tijarat qarar dey ker chupa diya aur Allah Taalaa uss say ba-khabar tha jo woh ker rahey thay
Aur unhon ney ussay boht hi halki qeemat per ginti kay chand dirhamon per hi baich dala, woh to Yusuf kay baray mein boht hi bey raghbat thay

Misir walon mein say jiss ney ussay khareeda tha uss ney apni biwi say kaha kay ussay boht izzat izzat-o-ehtram kay sath rakho, boht mumkin hai kay yeh humen faeedah phonchaye ya ussay hum apna beta hi bana len, yun hum ney misir ki zamin mein Yusuf ka qadam jama diya kay hum ussay khuwab ki tabeer ka kuch ilm sikha den. Allah apney iraday per ghalib hai lekin aksar log bey ilm hotay hain
Aur jab (Yusuf) pukhtagi ki umar ko phonch gaye hum ney ussay qooat faisla aur ilm diya, hum nek kaaron ko ussi tarah badla detay hain

Uss aurat ney jiss kay ghar mein Yusuf thay, Yusuf ko behlana phuslana shuroo kiya kay woh apney nafs ki nigrani chor dey aur darwazay band kerkay kehney lagi lo aajao Yusuf ney kaha Allah ki panah! woh mera rab hai, mujhay uss ney boht achi tarah rakha hai. Bey insafi kerney walon ka bhala nahi hota

Uss aurat ney Yusuf ki taraf qasad kiya aur Yusuf uss ka qasad kertay agar woh apney perwerdigar ki daleel na dekhtay, yunhi hua uss wastay kay hum uss say buraee aur bey hayaee door ker den. Bey shak woh humaray chuney huye bandon mein say tha

Dono darwazay ki taraf doray aur uss aurat ney Yusuf ka kerta peechay ki taraf say khench ker phaar dala aur darwazay kay pass hi aurat ka shoher dono ko mill gaya, to kehney lagi jo shakhs teri biwi kay sath bura iradah keray bus uss ki saza yehi hai kay ussay qaid ker diya jaye ya aur koi dard-naak saza di jaye.

Yusuf ney kaha yeh aurat hi mujhay phusla rahi thi, aur aurat kay qabeelay hi kay aik shakhs ney gawahi di kay agar uss ka kerta aagay say phata hua ho to aurat sachi hai aur Yusuf jhoot bolney walon mein say hai
Aur agar uss ka kerta peechay ki janib say phaara gaya hai to aurat jhooti hai aur Yusuf sachon mein say hai
Khawind ney jo dekha kay Yusuf ka kerta peeth ki janib say phaara gaya hai to saaf keh diya kay yeh to tum aurton ki chaal baazi hai, be-shak tumhari chaal baazi boht bari hai.
Yusuf abb uss baat ko aati jati kero aur (aey aurat) to apney gunah say tauba ker, be-shak to gunehgaron mein say hai.

Aur shehar ki aurton mein charcha honey laga kay aziz ki biwi apney (jawan) ghulam ko apna matlab nikalney kay liye behlaney phuslaney mein lagi rehti hai, unn kay dil mein Yusuf ki mohabbat beth gaee hai, humaray khayal mein to woh sareeh gumrahi mein hai

Uss ney jab unn ki uss per fareb gheebat ka haal suna to unhen bulwa bheja aur unn kay liye aik majlis muattab ki aur unn mein say her aik ko churi di. Aur kaha aey Yusuf! unn kay samney chalay aao, unn aurton ney jab ussay dekha to boht bara jana aur apney hath kaat liye, aur zaban say nikal gaya kay hasha-lillah! yeh insan to hergiz nahi, yeh to yaqeenan koi boht hi buzurg farishta hai

Uss waqt aziz misir ki biwi ney kaha, yehi hai jin kay baray mein tum mujhay tanay dey rahi thin, mein ney her chand uss say apna matlab hasil kerna chaha lekin yeh baal baal bacha raha, aur jo kuch mein uss say keh rahi hun agar yeh na keray ga to yaqeenan yeh qaid ker diya jaye ga aur be-shak yeh boht hi bey izzat hoga

Yusuf ney dua ki kay aey meray perwerdigar! jiss baat ki taraf yeh aurten mujhay bula rahi hain uss say to mujhay jail khana boht pasand hai, agar tu ney unn ka fun fareb mujh say door na kiya to mein to unn ki taraf maeel ho jaon ga aur bilkul nadanon mein jaa milon ga
Uss kay rab ney uss ki dua qabool ker li aur unn aurton kay dao paich uss say pher diye, yaqeenan woh sunnay wala jannay wala hai
Phir unn tamam nishaniyon kay dekh lenay kay baad bhi unhen yehi maslehat maloom hui kay Yusuf ko kuch muddat kay liye qaid khana mein rakhen

Uss kay sath hi do aur jawan bhi jail khaney mein dakhil huye, unn mein say aik ney kaha kay mein ney khuwab mein apney aap ko sharab nichortay dekha hai, aur doosray ney kaha mein ney apney aap ko dekha hai kay mein apney sir per roti uthaye huye hun jissay parinday kha rahey hain, humen aap uss ki tabeer batiye, humen to aap khoobiyon walay shakhs dikhaee detay hain

Yusuf) alaihi as-salam (ney kaha tumhen jo khana diya jata hai uss kay tumharay pass phonchney say pehlay hi mein tumhen uss ki tabeer batla doon ga. Yeh sab uss ilm ki badolat hai jo mujhay meray rab ney sikhaya hai, mein ney unn logon ka mazhab chor diya hai jo Allah per eman nahi rakhtay aur aakhirat kay bhi munkir hain

Mein apney baap dadon kay deen ka paband hun, yani Ibrahim o Ishaq aur Yaqoob kay deen ka, humen hergiz yeh sazawaar nahi kay hum Allah Taalaa kay sath kissi ko bhi shareek keren, hum per aur tamam aur logon per Allah Taalaa ka yeh khaas fazal hai, lekin aksar log na-shukri kertay hain
Aey meray qaid khaney kay sathiyo! kiya mutafarriq kaee aik perwerdigar behtar hain? Ya aik Allah zabardast taqatwar?

Uss kay siwa tum jin ki pooja paat ker rahey ho woh sab naam hi naam hain jo tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney khud hi gharr liye hain. Allah Taalaa ney unn ki koi daleel nazil nahi farmaee, farman-rawaee sirf Allah Taalaa hi ki hai, uss ka farman hai kay tum sab siwaye uss kay kissi aur ki ibadat na kero, yehi deen durust hai lekin aksar log nahi jantay

Aey meray qaid-khaney kay rafiqo! tum dono mein say aik to apney badshah ko sharab pilaney per muqarrar ho jaye ga, lekin doosra sooli per charhaya jaye ga aur parinday uss ka sar-noch noch khayen gay, tum dono jiss kay baray mein tehqeeq ker rahey thay uss kaam ka faisla kerdiya gaya

Aur jiss ki nisbat Yusuf ka guman tha kay unn dono mein say yeh choot jaye ga uss say kaha kay apney badshah say mera zikar bhi ker dena, phir ussay shetan ney apney badshah say zikar kerna bhala diya aur Yusuf ney kaee saal qaid-khaney mein hi kaatay

Badshah ney kaha, mein ney khuwab mein dekha hai kay saat moti taza farba gayen hain jin ko saat laaghar dubli patli gayen kha rahi hain aur saat baliyan hain hari hari aur doosri saat bilkul khushk. Aey darbariyo! meray uss khuwab ki tabeer batlao agar tum khuwab ki tabeer dey saktay ho
Unhon ney jawab diya kay yeh to urtay uratay pareshan khuwab hain aur aisay shoreedah pareshan khuwabon ki tabeer jannay walay hum nahi
Unn do qaidiyon mein say jo raha hua tha ussay muddat kay baad yaad aagaya aur kehney laga mein tumhen uss ki tabeer batla doon ga mujhay janey ki ijazat dijiye

Aey Yusuf! aey boht baray sachay Yusuf! aap humen uss khuwab ki tabeer batlaiye kay saat moti taza gayen hain jinhen saat dubli patli gayen kha rahi hain aur saat bilkul sabz khoshay hain aur saat hi doosray bilkul khushk hain, takay mein wapis ker unn logon say kahon kay woh sab jaan len
Yusuf ney jawab diya kay tum saat saal tak pay darpay lagataar hasb-e-aadat aadat ghalla boya kerna, aur fasal kaat ker ussay baaliyon samet hi rehney dena siwaye apney khaney ki thori si miqdaar kay
Uss kay baad saat saal nihayat sakht qehat aayen gay woh uss ghallay ko kha jayen gay, jo tum ney unn kay liye zakheera rakh chora tha, siwaye uss thoray say kay jo tum rok rakhtay ho
Uss kay baad jo saal aaye ga uss mein logon per khoob barish barsaee jaye gi aur uss mein (sheera angoor bhi) khoob nichoren gay

Aur badshah ney kaha Yusuf ko meray pass lao, jab qasid Yusuf kay pass phoncha to unhon ney kaha, apney badshah kay pass wapis jaa aur uss say pooch kay unn aurton ka haqeeqi waqiah kiya hai jinhon ney apney hath kaat liye, thay? Unn kay heelay ko (sahih tor per) jannay wala mera perwerdigar hi hai

Badshah ney poocha aey aurto! uss waqt ka sahih waqiah kiya hai jab tum dao fareb ker kay Yusuf ko uss ki dili mansha say behkana chahati thin, unhon ney saaf jawab diya kay maaz Allah hum ney Yusuf mein koi buraee nahi paee, phir to aziz ki biwi bhi bol uthi kay abb to sachi baat nithar aaee. Mein ney hi ussay warghalaya tha, uss kay ji say, aur yaqeenan woh sachon mein say hai
(Yusuf alaihi as-salam ney kaha) yeh uss wastay kay (aziz) jaan ley kay mein ney uss ki peeth peechay uss ki khayanat nahi ki aur yeh bhi kay Allah baazon kay hathkanday chalney nahi deta

Mein apney nafs ki pakeezgi biyan nahi kerta. Be-shak nafs to buraee per ubharney wala hi hai, magar yeh kay mera perwerdigar hi apna reham keray, yaqeenan mera paalney wala bari bakhsish kerney wala aur boht meharbani farmaney wala hai

Badshah ney kaha ussay meray pass lao kay mein ussay apney khaas kaamon kay liye muqarrar ker loon, phir jab uss say baat cheet ki to kehney laga kay aap humaray haan aaj say zee izzat aur amanat daar hain
(Yusuf ney) kaha aap mujhay mulk kay khazanon per muqarrar ker dijiye, mein hifazat kerney wala aur ba-khabar hun

Ussi tarah hum ney Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ko mulk ka qabzay dey diya. Kay woh jahan kahen chahaye rahey sahey, hum jissay chahayen apni rehmat phoncha detay hain. Hum neko kaaron ka sawab zaya nahi kertay
Yaqeenan eman daron aur perhez gaaron ka ukhrawi ajar boht hi behtar hai
Yusuf kay bhai aaye aur Yusuf kay pass gaye to uss ney unhen pehchan liya aur unhon ney ussay na pehchana

Jab unhen unn ka asbaab mohiyya ker diya to kaha kay tum meray pass apney uss bhai ko bhi lana jo tumharay baap say hai, kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay mein poora naap ker deta hun aur mein hun bhi behtareen maizbaani kerney walon mein
Pus agar tum ussay ley ker pass na aaye to meri taraf say tumhen koi naap bhi na milay ga balkay)yeh tum meray qareeb bhi na phatakna
Unhon ney kaha acha hum uss kay baap ko uss ki babat phuslayen gay aur poori koshish keren gay
Apney khidmat gaaron say kaha kay unn ki poonji unhi ki boriyon mein rakh do kay jab lot ker apney ahl o ayaal mein jayen aur poonjiyon ko pehchan len to boht mumkin hai kay yeh phir lot ker aayen

Jab yeh log lot ker apney walid kay pass gaye to kehney lagay kay hum say to ghalla ka naap rok liya gaya. Abb aap humaray sath humaray bhai ko bhejiye kay hum paymana bhar ker layen hum uss ki nigehbani kay zimmay daar hain

(Yaqoob alaihi as-salam ney) kaha kay mujhay to uss ki babat tumhara bus wesa hi aitbaar hai jaisa uss say pehlay uss kay bhai kay baray mein tha, bus Allah hi behtareen hafiz hai aur woh sab meharbano say bara meharban hai

Jab unhon ney apna asbaab khola to apna sarmaya mojood paya jo unn ki janib lota diya gaya tha. Kehney lagay aey humaray baap humen aur kiya chahaye. Dekhiye to yeh humara sarmaya bhi humen wapis lota diya gaya hai. Hum apney khandan ko rasad laaden gay aur apney bhai ki nigrani rakhen gay aur aik oont kay bojh ka ghalla ziyadah layen gay. Yeh naap to boht aasan hai

Yaqoob (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha! mein to ussay hergiz hergiz tumharay sath na bhejon ga jab tak kay tum Allah ko baich mein rakh ker mujhay qol o qarar na do kay tum ussay meray pass phoncha do gay, siwaye uss aik soorat kay kay tum sab giriftar ker liye jao. Jab unhon ney pakka qol qarar dey diya to unhon ney kaha kay hum jo kuch kehtay hain Allah uss per nigehbaan hai

Aur (Yaqoob alaihi as-salam) ney kaha aey meray bacho! tum sab aik darwazay say na jana balkay)yeh kaee juda juda darwazon mein say dakhil hona. Mein Allah ki taraf say aaney wali kissi cheez ko tum say taal nahi sakta. Hukum sirf Allah hi ka chalta hai. Mera kamil bharosa ussi per hai aur her aik bharosa kerney walay ko ussi per bharosa kerna chahaiye

Jab woh unhi raaston say jin ka hukum unn kay walid ney unhen diya tha, gaye. Kuch na tha kay Allah ney jo baat muqarrar ker di hai woh uss say unhen zara bhi bacha ley. Magar Yaqoob (alaihi as-salam) kay dil mein aik khayal (peda hua) jissay uss ney poora ker liya, bila-shuba woh humaray sikhlaye huye ilm ka aalam tha lekin aksar log nahi jantay
Yeh sab jab Yusuf kay pass phonch gaye to uss ney apney bhai ko apney pass bitha liya aur kaha mein tera bhai (Yusuf) hun, pus yeh jo kuch kertay rahey uss ka kuch ranj na ker

Phir jab unhen unn ka saman asbaab theek thaak kerkay diya to apney bhai kay asbaab mein pani peenay ka piyala rakh diya. Phir aik awaz denay walay ney pukar ker kaha kay aey qafilay walo! tum log to chor ho
Unhon ney unn ki taraf mun pher ker kaha kay tumhari kiya cheez khoi gaee hai?
Jawab diya kay shahi paymana gumm hai jo ussay ley ussay aik oont kay bojh ka ghalla milay ga. Uss waday ka mein zaamin hun
Unhon ney kaha Allah ki qasam! tum ko khoob ilm hai kay hum mulk mein fasad phelaney kay liye nahi aaye aur na hum chor hain
Unhon ney kaha acha chor ki kiya saza hai agar tum jhootay ho?
Jawab diya kay uss ki saza yehi hai kay jiss kay asbaab mein say paya jaye o hi uss ka badla hai. Hum to aisay zalimon ko yehi saza diya kertay hain

Pus Yusuf ney unn kay saman ki talashi shuroo ki, apney bhai kay saman ki talashi say pehlay, phir uss paymana ko apney bhai kay saman (zanbeel) say nikala. Hum ney Yusuf kay liye ussi tarah yeh tadbeer ki. Uss badshah kay qanoon ki roo say yeh apney bhai ko na ley sakta tha magar yeh kay Allah ko manzoor ho. Hum jiss kay chahayen darjay buland ker den, her zee ilm per foqiyat rakhney wala doosra zee ilm mojood hai

Unhon ney kaha kay agar uss ney chori ki (to koi tajjub ki baat nahi) uss bhai bhi pehlay chori ker chuka hai. Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ney uss baat ko apney dil mein rakh liya aur unn kay samney bilkul zahir na kiya. Kaha kay tum badtar jagah mein ho, aur jo tum biyan kertay ho ussay Allah hi khoob janta hai
Unhon ney kaha kay aey aziz misir! uss kay walid boht bari umar kay bilkul boorhay shakhs hain. Aap uss kay badlay hum mein say kissi ko ley lijiye. Hum dekhtay hain kay aap baray nek nafs hain

Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha hum ney jiss kay pass apni cheez paee hai uss kay siwa doosray ki giriftari kerney say Allah ki panah chahatay hain, aisa kerney say to hum yaqeenan insafi kerney walay ho jayen gay

Jab yeh uss say mayyus ho gaye to tanahi mein beth ker mashwara kerney lagay. Unn mein jo sab say bara tha uss ney kaha tumhen maloom nahi kay tumharay walid ney tum say Allah ki qasam ley ker pukhta qol qarar liya hai aur uss say pehlay Yusuf kay baray mein tum kotahi ker chukay ho. Pus mein to uss zamin say na taloo ga jab tak kay walid sahib-e-eman khud mujhay ijazat na den ya Allah Taalaa meray moamlay ka faisla ker dey, o hi behtareen faisla kerney wala hai

Tum sab walid sahib-e-eman ki khidmat mein wapis jao aur kaho kay abba ji! aap kay sahibzaday ney chori ki aur hum ney o hi gawahi di thi jo hum jantay thay. Hum kuch ghaib ki hifazat kerney walay na thay
Aap uss shehar kay logon say daryaft farma len jahan hum thay aur uss qafila say bhi pooch len jiss kay sath hum aaye hain, aur yaqeenan hum bilkul sachay hain

(Yaqoob alaihi as-salam ney) kaha yeh to nahi, balkay)yeh tum ney apni taraf say baat bana, pus abb sabar hi behtar hai. Qareeb hai kay Allah Taalaa unn sab ko meray pass hi phoncha dey. Woh hi ilm o hikmat wala hai
Phir unn say mun pher liya aur kaha haaye Yusuf! unn ki aankhen ba-waja ranj o ghum kay safaid ho chuki thin aur woh ghum ko dabaye huye thay
Beton ney kaha o Allah! aap hamesha Yusuf ki yaad hi mein lagay rahen gay yahan tak kay ghul jayen ya khatam hi ho jayen
Unhon ney kaha kay mein to apni pareshaniyon aur ranj ki faryad Allah hi say ker raha hun, mujhay Allah ki taraf say woh baaten maloom hain jo tum nahi jantay

Meray piyaray bacho! tum jao aur Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) ki aur uss kay bhai ki poori tarah talash kero aur Allah ki rehmat say na-umeed na ho. Yaqeenan rab ki rehmat say na-umeed o hi hotay hain jo kafir hotay hain

Phir jab yeh log Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) kay pass phonchay to kehney lagay kay aey aziz! hum ko aur humaray khaandan ko dukh phoncha hai. Hum haqeer poonji laye hain pus aap humen pooray ghalla ka naap dijiye aur hum per kheyraat kijiye, Allah Taalaa kheyraat kerney walon ko badla deta hai
Yusuf ney kaha jantay bhi ho kay tum ney Yusuf aur uss kay bhai kay sath apni nadani ki halat mein kiya kiya?

Unhon ney kaha kiya (waqaee) to hi Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) hai. Jawab diya kay haan mein Yusuf (alaihi as-salam) hun aur yeh mera bhai hai. Allah ney hum per fazal o karam kiya, baat yeh hai kay jo bhi perhez gaari aur sabar keray to Allah Taalaa kissi nekokaar ka ajar zaya nahi kerta
Unhon ney kaha Allah ki qasam! Allah Taalaa ney tujhay hum per bartari di hai aur yeh bhi bilkul sach hai kay hum khata kaar thay
Jawab diya aaj tum per koi malamat nahi hai. Allah tumhen bakhshay, woh sab meharbano say bara meharban hai
Mera yeh kerta tum ley jao aur ussay meray walid kay mun per daal do kay woh dekhney lagen, aur aajayen aur apney tamam khandan ko meray pass ley
Jab yeh qafila juda hua to unn kay walid ney kaha kay mujhay to Yusuf ki khushboo aarahi hai agar tum mujhay sathyaya hua qarar na do
Woh kehney lagay kay o Allah aap apney ussi puraney khabt mein mubtila hain

Jab khushkhabri denay walay ney phonch ker unn kay mun per woh kerta dala ussi waqt woh phir say beena hogaye. Kaha! kiya mein tum say na kaha kerta tha kay mein Allah ki taraf say woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay
Unhon ney kaha abba ji! aap humaray liye gunahon ki bakhsish talab kijiye be-shak hum qusoor waar hain
Kaha acha mein jald hi tumharay liye apney perwerdigar say bakhsish maangoon ga, woh boht bara bakhshney wala aur nihayat meharbani kerney o laa hai
Jab yeh sara gharana Yusuf kay pass phonch gaya to Yusuf ney apney maa baap ko apney pass jagah di aur kaha kay Allah ko manzoor hai to aap sab aman mein kay sath misir mein aao

Aur apney takht per apney maa baap ko ooncha bithaya aur sab uss kay samney sajday mein gir gaye. Tab kaha kay abba ji! yeh meray pehlay kay khuwab ki tabeer hai meray rab ney ussay sacha ker dikhaya, uss ney meray sath bara ehsan kiya jab kay mujhay jail khaney say nikala aur aap logon ko sehra say ley aaya uss ikhtilaf kay baad jo shetan ney mujh mein aur meray bhaiyon mein daal diya tha. Mera rab jo chahaye uss kay liye behtareen tadbeer kerney wala hai. Aur woh boht ilm o hikmat wala hai

Aey meray perwerdigar! tu ney mujhay mulk ata farmaya aur tu ney mujhay khuwab ki tabeer sikhlaee. Aey aasman o zamin kay peda kerney walay! to hi duniya o aakhirat mein mera o li (dost) aur kaarsaaz hai, to mujhay islam ki halat mein fot ker aur nekon mein mila dey
Yeh ghaib ki khabron mein say hai jiss ki hum aap ki taraf wahee ker rahey hain. Aap unn kay pass na thay jab kay unhon ney apni baat thaan li thi aur woh fareb kerney lagay thay
Go aap lakh chahayen lekin aksar log eman daar na hun gay
Aap unn say uss per koi ujrat talab nahi ker rahey hain. Yeh to tamam duniya kay liye niri naseehat hi naseehat hai
Aasmano aur zamin mein boht si nishaniyan hain. Jin say yeh mun moray guzar jatay hain
Unn mein say aksar log bawajood Allah per eman rakhney kay bhi mushrik hi hain
Kiya woh uss baat say bey khof hogaye hain kay unn kay pass Allah kay azabon mein say koi aam azab aajaye ya unn per achanak qayamat toot paray aur woh bey khabar hi hun
Aap keh dijiye meri raah yehi hai. Mein aur meray muttabeyeen Allah ki taraf bula rahey hain, pooray yaqeen aur aetmaad kay sath. Aur Allah pak hai aur mein mushrikon mein nahi

Aap say pehlay hum ney basti walon mein jitney rasool bhejay hain sab mard hi thay jin ki taraf hum wahee nazil farmatay gaye. Kiya zamin mein chal phir ker unhon ney dekha nahi kay unn say pehlay kay logon ka kaisa kuch anjam hua? Yaqeenan aakhirat ka ghar perhezgaron kay liye boht hi behtar hai, kiya phir bhi tum nahi samajhtay

Yahan tak kay jab rasool na-umeed honey lagay aur woh (qom kay log) khayal kerney lagay kay unhen jhoot kaha gaya. Foran hi humari madad unn kay pass phonchi jissay hum ney chaha ussay nijat di gaee. Baat yeh hai kay humara azab gunehgaron say wapis nahi kiya jata

Unn kay biyan mein aqal walon kay liye yaqeenan naseehat aur ibrat hai, yeh Quran jhoot banaee hui baat nahi balkay)yeh yeh tasdeeq hai unn kitabon ki jo uss say pehlay ki hain, khol khol ker biyan kerney wala hai her cheez ko aur hidayat aur rehmat hai eman daar logon kay liye
